text: 中金所党委书记、董事长何庆文在“2026上海衍生品市场论坛”上表示，中金所稳步推进扩大对外开放，为境外投资者提供多样化的风险管理工具，持续提升中国资产的吸引力。今年4月，合格境外投资者（QFI）参与国债期货交易正式落地，目前共有39家QFI备案将国债期货纳入投资品种范围，11家QFI已经获批国债期货套保额度，促进更多国际配置性资金进入我国的债券市场。目前，中金所根据中国证监会统一部署，正扎实推进人民币外汇期货试点准备工作，确保试点平稳推出。
text_en: He Qingwen, Party Committee Secretary and Chairman of the China Financial Futures Exchange (CFFEX), said at the 2026 Shanghai Derivatives Market Forum that CFFEX is steadily advancing the expansion of opening-up, providing overseas investors with diversified risk management tools, and continuously enhancing the appeal of Chinese assets. In April this year, Qualified Foreign Investors (QFI) participation in treasury bond futures trading was officially implemented. Currently, a total of 39 QFIs have filed to include treasury bond futures in their investment scope, and 11 QFIs have been approved for treasury bond futures hedging quotas, promoting more international allocation funds to enter China's bond market. At present, under the unified arrangements of the CSRC, CFFEX is solidly advancing preparations for the pilot program of RMB foreign exchange futures to ensure its smooth launch.
